title: Uniform projective resolution bound for finite perfect quotients
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring and $I\subset A$ an ideal, with $P_n=A/I^n$ as in [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Suppose every $P_n$ is finite as a set and perfect as an $A$-module [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex]. There is a nonnegative integer $r$, independent of $n\geq1$, such that every $P_n$ has a resolution by finitely generated projective $A$-modules concentrated in degrees $[-r,0]$. Equivalently its tensor with any $A$-module has cohomology only in $[-r,0]$. The zero quotient is allowed.

source.place: Tag 090V, proposition-Auslander-Buchsbaum: applied to the nonzero finite-length localizations of the perfect quotients. The common-bound conclusion is an agent assembly, not the literal statement of 090V.
